answer: A honeypot canary scheme inserts unannounced test work into the task stream. 1) Each epoch the scheduler kernel gives every identity a 1-in-40 draw of a canary job, e.g. classifying 200 walnut photos with labels pre-verified by three graders. 2) A failed or skipped canary burns the 2.0-unit escrow; two consecutive skips tag the identity as an island cohort, sampled at triple rate. 3) Cost: 20 sybils lock 40.0 units, expected hits are 0.5 per epoch, so after 10 epochs survival is (39/40)^200, under 0.7% - operators risk 40 units to recover small fees.
